read.title: Packing Details for PO #3108
read.text:
Dear Mr. Novak,

Your order is almost ready for shipment. Before we pack it, we'd like to confirm the following:

1. Each carton will hold 60 sheet mask boxes.
2. Each pallet will hold 36 cartons, wrapped in plastic.
3. The shipping mark will include your company name, the PO number, and the carton number.

Please note that we cannot add your own labels after the cartons are sealed. If you have any changes, please let us know by Tuesday.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
